messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning KEK rotation next Tue (2026-03-23) across AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault. Need RBAC changes, audit hooks, and a manual rewrap fallback. Thoughts?
Maria: Quick Q — what are the backward-compat constraints? We still have ciphertexts with header v1 (no provider uri) and v2 (provider+kek).
Kevin: Plan idea: runtime supports version negotiation for a 30d grace period. Accept v1 and v2, but write new encryptions as v2. For old objects we need an automated rewrap path (decrypt w/old KEK -> encrypt w/new KEK).
Samantha: Rollout timing proposal: staged canary 48h per region (1% tenants), then 2-day ramp to 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Manual rewrap only for canary set initially. Also add throttles so rewraps don't spike GPU/IO.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rotation job created: 2026-03-23T02:00Z — canary window enabled. Link: https://console.internal/rotations/2012345678
Julian: Audit/logging: we must capture every rewrap op to audit-bucket (s3://redwood-audit/kek-rewraps/). Fields: actor, service_account, source_kek, target_kek, object_id, op_duration, checksum_before, checksum_after. Retention: propose 7 years for compliance.
Priya: RBAC notes: create iam role 'kms:rewrap' scoped to rewrap service account. Deny app nodes direct KMS decrypt for KEKs used only by rewrap. Add JIT approval for emergency manual runs.
Alex: Failure modes — manual rollback plan: keep pre-rewrap snapshots (object_version) and mark objects state="pending_rewrap" during operation. If error rate > 1% for a tenant, abort and rollback those tenants using snapshots.
Maria: Backcompat detail — ensure runtime can still parse v1 headers; include a migration utility that injects provider tag before re-encrypting. Also update embedding store index format to include kek_version.
Kevin: Vulnerability triage: if CVE in KMS SDKs, pause rotation immediately. Run offline rewrap in an isolated HSM-backed environment with pinned client libs. Escalate to SRE + Sec.
Samantha: Ops playbook: add monitors — rewrap_error_rate, rewrap_latency_p95, rewrap_throughput, gpu_queue_depth. Pager threshold: error_rate > 0.5% for 5m. Incident runbook step sample: 1) pause rotation, 2) triage logs, 3) rollback snapshots for affected tenants, 4) revoke new KEK if corruption suspected.
Kevin: Rewrap snippet (example for AWS):
```bash
# sample aws re-encrypt (one object)
aws kms re-encrypt \
  --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin \
  --source-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/old-kek \
  --destination-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/new-kek \
  --output fileb://ct2.bin
```
Julian: Also capture success/failure to audit logs with signed metadata. Add signature verification step on rewrap completion to ensure integrity (checksum_before == checksum_after after decrypt/encrypt).
Priya: Policy snippet idea (IAM) — minimal: allow kms:ReEncrypt on target/destination keys only for rewrap-service role, deny kms:Decrypt on old KEKs for regular app roles. I'll draft a PR.
Alex: Notes for Private/on-prem: allow offline manual rewrap tool that uses customer-managed HSM. Provide a 'dry-run' mode to validate checksums and headers without writing.
Maria: Tests: create unit vectors for v1->v2, v2->v2, and corrupted-header cases. Include automated smoke that picks random objects and validates roundtrip.
Samantha: Performance: schedule heavy rewraps during off-peak, rate-limit per-tenant. Ensure KV cache invalidation is safe — add 'rewrap_version' to cache keys so old cached entries don't crash inference.
Alex: Action items: Maria -> header compatibility matrix + test vectors. Kevin -> rewrap tool stress tests + container images. Priya -> RBAC policy PR + JIT flow. Julian -> audit retention policy + signed-logs schema. Samantha -> runbook + monitors. I'll coordinate timeline. Sync Thu 10:00am in #eng-security. :thumbsup:
Maria: ack
Kevin: ack
Priya: ack
Julian: adding doc to drives now: https://drive.internal/security/kek-rotation/overview.md
Samantha: adding runbook checklist to ops runbooks.
Alex: Thanks — we'll keep the canary small and iterate.
